CustomField.description: System-maintained snapshot of the NDA_Expiry_Date__c value that NDA_Alert_Last_Interval__c was computed against. When this differs from the live NDA_Expiry_Date__c, the marker is treated as blank and the whole expiry reminder ladder re-arms. Clearing this field re-arms the ladder. Not for manual entry.
CustomField.label: NDA Alert Expiry Date
